name: HumaCarb 2.0
tagline: Humic substances to stabilize nutrients & improve fertilizer efficiency
description:
Our new and improved HumaCarb 2.0 is a source of stable humic substances that improves soil microbiology and aids in the uptake of nutrients in the root zone to reduce potential fertilizer loss.

Soluble nutrient fertilizers are unstable and can be leached out of the root zone or become complexed by soil minerals very quickly. This is especially the case for anions such as nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur, as well as for trace minerals. By preventing leaching, HumaCarb allows you to use fertilizer more efficiently. 

We’ve improved the formula by thickening the solution and increasing its viscosity, so the humic solids stay in suspension and don’t solidify. It’s a game-changer that makes HumaCarb much easier to use.

Our R&D team is constantly working to improve our products to make them perform better in the field and be easier to use–always supporting our goal of helping growers succeed. 

Product availability varies due to state-by-state product regulations. Please check your state’s current availability here.

Rebound™ Copper is an organic copper solution uniquely processed for maximum plant uptake.

Product availability varies due to state-by-state product regulations. Please check availability in your state here.

details.title: Application Rates
details.body:
Row starter: Apply up to 1 gallon per acre.

Broadacre crop foliar: Apply up to 1 gallon per acre, every 3-4 weeks.

Fruit and vegetable foliar: Apply up to 1 gallon per acre per w

details.title: Application Instructions
details.body: Rebound™ products are best applied as foliars. They are also effective when applied to the soil and via fertigation.

details.title: Ingredients
details.body:
Guaranteed analysis:

Copper (Cu) ... 2%

Derived from: Copper sulfate

details.title: National Organic Program Information
details.body: This product is suitable for use under NOP. Please check with your certifier before using.
